book.name: Evesus
book.title: Evesus Sesoava Moakot Vev Hevtindimba Kristusinda.

content: Kava Pol, kava moalamangnindrini Kristus Yesusna. Kava moalamangnindrini, noinda osm Sesoava mindnamba undva vrevna. Kava yem novol vinna Sesoatindim Evesuskotaram, ten ye avm, keknam undnahonam Kristus Yesusinda.
Sesoa pina aral, eva mendekli Yesus Kristus yemoa undalm vewol evevra, wo osva yimba si undwonam avav.
Pimba Mongawundna Keknam Avna Kristusindamba.
Okulu Sesoam aram pivna mendeklinam Yesus Kristusnam. Kristusinda Sesoava daswolna pimba manimani besalmba senakembellininamba, pina undmba nonapopolmba almba.

Kristusinda himba doara pimba kikih vewol vena, nonam pethava mendah venamoa. Himba pimba und vewol vevna, wo noinda himba pimba kikih vewol vena hevelm, osm ora owaimomolva sewonamba si pinamba indkoklava luhungu vinvavmoa.

Wo mendah pethamba os venamoa, Sesoava kikih vewol vevna, vewol velm pimba hevna towandalalm. Sesoava nengna, Yesus Kristusva si wohmuhulkohovav honamba kana nengavnangva. Temba osm himba und vevna, kaoa honindaoa indk vethara.
Honanata okuliv Sesoamba, noinda henamba indva wohlohv, pim kolvrowolalm. Sesoava mindnam und vevna hevna ombolmba, wo henapopol himba pimba undalm vewol vena. Wo noinda pioa hemoa okolalvohra.
Kristus doa pimba kilumbshuawol vena, manara noinda hena tovol sovhopena, dahavnam. Wo pinamba indkoklamba doa maikumi vinna, manara noinda Sesoava pimba mindnam undalm vewol vena.

Sesoava pimba mindnam undalm vewol vena, kivrawulihahui. Seilva komandhalohvna, wo heva os pimba doa levrapivolna hena nengavnangva. Honamba osm Sesoava nengna, wo himba nengavnangva vrena, velmba Kristusinda.

Henamba honamba si osangas hev hoanavho vrungavav nengavnangva sewonamba, nambainonoa mendekli si nonam provavm. Himba osm nengavnangva kokolma vrena, manimani senamini, eva petharinim si mongawulm sithawolvav Kristusinda kuwulinda.

Kristusinda Sesoa pimba kikih vewol vena hevtindilmba, Sesoava doara heva doa pimba kikih vewol vena, noinda henamba nengavnangva os lohv. Sesoava memba noi hev venam, manimani lehra lohv, noinda hev ten velm nengvnam.
Kava Yutanind miva lovahthamnana undnahonamba Kristusmba, manara, kamba kikih vewol vena, osm kava okulivra Sesoana pusambamba.

Doa ten luhunv yeinda kana ungundinda. Yimba hillivna moanonoam besal nemelmom, osm yemba noi lopshavra. Nonamba yimba hillivnamba, yimba keknam undnahonam lovahthamnana Kristusmba. Wo Kristusinda Sesoava yemba kanothowol vena, daswolna hevsongolm, nom engvna hevna omokalthamom.

No Sesoasongolta pimba novpa wuleihinna, osm pimba si dumbvav, nomba temba Sesoava moamba omokalthinnamba hevtindimba. Wo honana Sesoava si pimba wohmuehvav hevelmangas. Wo si pimba avra Sesoana moainal indhana, osm okulivra Sesoana nihilmba.
Polna Sembayangmoa.

Noindata kava elsusva nengewuluhunv yemba kavna sembayangnamba, wo eva elsus omnalohv, Sesoa, yimba lehra. Kava osangas elsus honamba vawolohvna, nonamba kava hillinvnamba yenamba undmba, osva keknam amnav mendeklim Yesusm, eva und vewol viv owalm Sesoatindim.

Kava elsus sembayang velohmanav Sesoamba, pina mendeklina Yesus Kristusna aralmba. Himba pina arata, pusambara lohv. Kava osm sembayang vawov, himba si daswolvav yemba hevsongolva, osm nomba si yemba koldombvav, Sesoamba lihalmba beswonamba. Nomba nowolva, hev ten doara yem vrahunnam.

Kava osm sembayang vawov, yimba si mindnam temura wohlevrapivolvav pevna nengavnangva. Wo osva si yimba levrapivolvav vuhe besalva, nomba Sesoava temba kokolma vinnamba, pimba memba himba doa kekaiv venamba hevelm. Kava osm sembayang vawovna, yimba si levrapivolvav, nomba awothowolalva besalva, Sesoava hev moamba omokalthinna hevtindimba. Hevm besal snal i, eva pivva manam seihvav.
Wo yimba si nunglivav Sesoana keknasowolva mendeklinonoa, pim kolvrowolalm, pimba memba keknamba undnahonamba avpa. Nomba keknasowolva andrava Sesoanamba,
nonata, Sesoava nona wolaihaphona Kristusmba pokamariniva, wo desvhoana hemba hevna nihanasis senakembellava.

Sesoava vrena Kristusmba, mendeklikuwul wulluhunilm ovsongolnindna manimani, eva tihsongona manimani. Kristusangas senava kuwul mendekliva wulluhunv manana manana hona petharava, eva temba si sewonamba phovavpa.
Sesoava hemba vrena, ona, yimba kuwul wulluhunv manana manana. Wo osoa himba hemba vrena, kuwulm wulluhunilm pim Sesoatindim.

Sesoatindiva Kristusna nihmsna av. Sesoatindiva Kristusnamba nihm wohlihna, os engla lahaiwo ahavna, mongla lahaiwo ahavna, snal, snal temura, mongova shalohnamoa nihsowosalva. Wo eva Kristusva yunalm lundthoana manam manam.
